body: This prebiotics jelly serum completely saved my skin barrier. After starting daily red light therapy, I needed something deeply hydrating that wouldn't sting or congest my pores. This absorbs in seconds and leaves my face feeling completely soothed.
The texture of this jelly serum is divine! It glides on cool, sinks in without any tackiness, and works seamlessly under my Buudy LED mask. My skin looks visibly calmer and more balanced.
I have reactive, redness-prone combination skin, and finding a barrier serum that doesn't trigger breakouts has always been impossible until now. 2 weeks in, my cheeks are calm and hydrated all day.
Zero light scattering is so true! I apply this right before putting on my LED face mask. Not only does it protect my skin from dryness, but the glow afterwards is literally unreal.
Obsessed with the weightless jelly consistency. It leaves skin bouncy and supple with a gorgeous natural finish. No greasy film, no heavy fragrance, just pure barrier care.
My dermatologist recommended adding prebiotics to my routine to support my skin microbiome, and this formula is outstanding. The 2% concentration works wonders for calming irritation.
Such an elegant formula. Dual hyaluronic acid gives that instant quench and plumping effect, while the prebiotics keep my barrier resilient through cold British weather.
Finally, a serum that doesn't pill under moisturiser or sunscreen! It feels refreshing upon application, dries down clean, and keeps tightness at bay all day long.
I noticed a huge difference in my skin's recovery time after blemishes. The combination of prebiotics and Sodium PCA calms inflammation and prevents those dry, flaky aftermath patches.
Great prebiotic serum. Feels lightweight and soothing on sensitive skin. Pairs well with the LED mask with zero irritation.
Using this consistently morning and night. My skin feels noticeably denser, hydrated, and so much less reactive to environmental stress.
I love that it's ECOCERT certified natural. Knowing it's 99% natural origin without silicone or artificial fillers gives me complete peace of mind.
Pairing this with the Buudy LED mask has transformed my skincare routine. My skin is noticeably plumper, fine lines look softened, and redness has faded dramatically.
Immediate soothing effect. If your skin barrier ever feels compromised from active treatments or weather, this provides instant comfort without stinging.
Weightless, deeply hydrating, and balances oil production surprisingly well. My T-zone stays matte while my dry cheeks feel comfortable all day.
Five stars! The light fluid jelly texture feels so cooling. It preps skin perfectly for light therapy and washes off mask silicone diodes easily with just a damp cloth.
My complexion looks so fresh and rested. Even my esthetician remarked on how hydrated and calm my skin barrier looks recently.
Outstanding formulation. It delivers everything it promises: microbiome support, deep hydration, and zero sticky residue. Will definitely repurchase.
Hands down the best barrier serum I have tested. Plumps fine dehydration lines around the mouth and forehead within minutes.
Gives that coveted glass-skin finish without looking shiny or greasy. Absorbs completely in under 30 seconds.
